title: Show step-counter availability in the System Info sensor summary
summary: DeviceInfo includes the step counter in the key-sensor presence list using getDefaultSensor without registering a listener. Evaluate carrying that presence check to FastMediaSorter while retaining its permission-gated sensor filtering.
evidence: DeviceInfo keySensorsSummary includes TYPE_STEP_COUNTER; the source keySensorsSummary does not. The source still filters that sensor from the full list.
acceptance: On hardware with a step counter, the key-sensor summary names it without sampling it or requesting an additional permission; otherwise it does not. Cover the absence case and the existing filter.

title: Review notification recovery for watch System Info reports
summary: DeviceInfo offers a notification explanation, permission request and settings route. Evaluate the corresponding FastMediaSorter watch-report flow and reuse its existing permission architecture where needed.
evidence: The source receiver returns a refusal when notifications are disabled; the standalone app includes a recovery flow. FastMediaSorter already has notification-permission flows elsewhere, so the source ticket must first determine which one applies.
acceptance: A person receiving a watch report can discover and enable the notification permission through an appropriate existing or new source-product flow, including after refusal. Verify the source behaviour on Android 13 or newer.

title: Review System Info target sizing and disclosure state on phone and Wear OS
summary: Evaluate the S0023 target-size, disclosure-marker, accessibility and remembered watch-group changes against FastMediaSorter's current components; carry only missing behavior and preserve its existing accessibility work.
source: app_v2 and wear System Info UI and shared section components
evidence: The upstream watch screen and information rows use corresponding section and combined-click components, and its expansion store is process-scoped. Its phone header already has its own accessible-state handling, so the source comparison must be clause-by-clause. DeviceInfo's new code is not built or device-verified.
acceptance: On the source phone and watch, verify actual target bounds, disclosure state and separate header actions, rotary scrolling and durable group choices without regressing existing accessibility or data. Keep remaining contract exceptions visible.

title: Review keyboard search and save shortcuts in System Info
summary: Evaluate routing Ctrl+F to the report search and Ctrl+S to its existing save command, with localized shortcut hints, in FastMediaSorter System Info.
evidence: A source search of the upstream System Info activity and window manager found no Ctrl+F or Ctrl+S handler; other input dispatch outside those files was not ruled out. DeviceInfo's new shortcut route is unbuilt and unverified on hardware.
acceptance: Check source-wide input routing first, then verify each shortcut invokes the same search or save path as the visible control without stealing text-editing or system keys.

title: Review content-sized group packing, search disclosure, viewport memory and watch action buttons in System Info
summary: Evaluate carrying DeviceInfo S0023 changes to FastMediaSorter System Info: collapsed phone group headers packed at their content widths, a header activation that closes or reopens a group during search, the activated header kept as the viewport anchor with the viewport remembered as anchor plus offset on phone and watch, and the watch actions as wrapping content-sized buttons instead of full-width one-line chips.
source: app_v2 and wear System Info UI and shared section components
evidence: DeviceInfo packs collapsed headers on a one-span-per-dp grid and the upstream grid uses equal columns; the watch actions were one-line toolkit chips. Compiled-not-tested: nothing here has run on a device, and the span arithmetic, anchor lookup and viewport store have unrun unit tests.
acceptance: On the source phone and watch, verify header widths and wrapping at narrow and wide sizes, that a header tapped during search closes and reopens, that the activated header stays in view and the viewport returns after a relaunch, and that enlarged text grows the watch actions without clipping, without regressing existing accessibility or data.

title: Review the interface size scale in System Info
summary: Evaluate carrying DeviceInfo S0023 exception E1 to FastMediaSorter System Info: one app-wide interface scale of 100, 115, 130 and 150 percent, independent of the system text size, chosen from the overflow menu on the phone (a dialog that re-creates the screen) and by a stepping button on the watch, and applied as a density override of the screen.
source: app_v2 and wear System Info UI
evidence: Upstream System Info has no interface scale: its screens follow the system font and display size only. The DeviceInfo mechanism compiles and its unit tests pass; nothing has run on a device or an emulator, and survival of the density override through AppCompat's configuration handling is unverified.
acceptance: On the source phone and watch, verify that each step scales text, glyphs, spacing and targets together, that the system font scale still applies on top, that the 48 dp targets grow and never shrink, that the choice survives a relaunch, and that an unsupported stored value shows the baseline, without regressing existing accessibility or data.

title: Carry the System Info field-header checks of the phone unit test to FastMediaSorter
summary: Evaluate carrying the phone test checks of the System Info summary to FastMediaSorter: header checks for the battery, extended metric, sensor and media fields, together with the battery broadcast context that lets the battery checks run under Robolectric. The FastMediaSorter GatherSystemInfoUseCaseTest checks only the section headers, the app version, the benchmark format and the empty-contributor case.
evidence: The upstream test has five checks. The destination test adds three header checks, present since the initial import (commit c12f2d4), and under S0037 the battery broadcast context that the battery check needs. Every string key the added checks name is produced by upstream main code: PlatformDetailsCollector, SensorsDiagnosticsCollector, MediaAudioDiagnosticsCollector and GatherSystemInfoUseCase. Under Robolectric the battery headers are absent without a sticky ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED intent (S0037).
acceptance: On the source, the carried checks pass in the source unit-test command with the same battery context, and the five upstream checks are unchanged. Not run in this repository: the upstream checkout is read-only here and no FastMediaSorter build or test was run.

title: Keep the watch System information title inside a round screen
summary: DeviceInfo S0043 adds a 12 dp horizontal inset to the main System information title of the watch, so its wrapped lines stay inside a round 454 px display. The upstream title item has the same string, style and alignment but no inset, so the title clipped on the round emulator in Russian (S0029) probably occurs in FastMediaSorter too. Evaluate carrying the inset once the DeviceInfo look is confirmed on a device.
evidence: Static reading only. Upstream title item at lines 136-145: a title2 Text with fillMaxWidth and bottom padding and no horizontal inset. DeviceInfo title item at lines 177-190: the same Text plus padding(horizontal = TITLE_HORIZONTAL_INSET), added by S0043. The upstream sourceSha256 04d3d000 matches docs/port-ledger.jsonl. The clip is not measured on the FastMediaSorter watch.
acceptance: On a round 454 px watch in ru (and in uk and en) the System information title of FastMediaSorter is whole, wraps to at most two lines and is not clipped at either edge. Shown by a device or emulator run of the FastMediaSorter checkout; static reading does not close it.
